note: 十段连续双语草稿；仅文本词数代理，待口音试听及音频时长验收，不填时间轴。设计：保留证据，隔离陈旧缓存，核验制品与幂等状态后分批恢复。

series.title: 构建全红：陈旧缓存与安全恢复队列
series.premise: 上午九点共享构建队列全部失败，生产版本未变；排查runner、依赖源和缓存。
series.outcome: 旧缓存携带退役依赖镜像地址；隔离该缓存后冷构建正常。保留失败证据，核验签名、来源和凭据边界，去重重试并恢复队列；缓存键修复仍待评审。

accentTarget.basis: spoken audio duration excluding silence and narration

recycling.note: 候选未来回访不计实际复现；实际引用仅来自已有库、S03至S07及本文件前段。

dialogues.title: 构建全红，生产是否受影响
dialogues.premise: 九点构建面板全红，尚未确认失败阶段。
dialogues.listeningTask: 区分构建失败与生产故障，听出第一步约束。

lines.en: Okay, the pipeline's red across projects. I'll take point on this.
lines.zh: 好，各项目流水线全红了。我来协调。

lines.en: Failures started around nine this morning. Let me tail the log.
lines.zh: 失败大约从今天九点开始。我盯一下日志。

lines.en: Which step failed on those runs? Don't retry everything before we know.
lines.zh: 这些运行在哪一步失败？没查清之前别全部重试。

lines.en: Dependency fetch, before any artifact upload. Production still serves yesterday's version, right?
lines.zh: 在上传制品前的依赖下载阶段。生产仍是昨天版本，对吧？

lines.en: Yes, production's deployment digest hasn't changed. Build failures aren't proof of exposure.
lines.zh: 对，生产部署摘要没变。构建失败不代表已发生泄漏。

lines.en: Our working hypothesis is shared infrastructure. Three unrelated commits fail alike.
lines.zh: 当前假设是共享基础设施。三个无关提交以同样方式失败。

lines.en: Shared infrastructure... maybe, but compare timestamps. A common dependency could explain it.
lines.zh: 共享设施……有可能，但对比时间戳。共同依赖也可能解释。

lines.en: Just to confirm, preserve failed runs. What's the ETA for scope?
lines.zh: 确认一下，保留失败运行。预计多久圈定范围？

lines.en: I'll preserve access-controlled logs and metadata. No secret values in this channel.
lines.zh: 我保留受限日志和元数据。这个频道不放秘密值。

lines.en: About two minutes for affected projects. I'll tell developers retries are paused.
lines.zh: 受影响项目大约两分钟查完。我通知开发先暂停重试。

dialogues.title: 队列影响与已经执行的任务
dialogues.premise: 生产未变，失败集中在依赖下载；开始盘点队列和副作用。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出为何失败状态不能直接授权重试。

lines.en: Forty queued builds are waiting now. Twelve earlier attempts failed fetching dependencies.
lines.zh: 现在四十个构建排队。之前十二次尝试下载依赖失败。

lines.en: Okay, that's our blast radius currently. Just to confirm, no production deployments?
lines.zh: 好，这是目前影响范围。确认一下，没有生产部署？

lines.en: Check deployment receipts, not dashboard colors. A failed run might complete side effects.
lines.zh: 查部署回执，别只看面板颜色。失败运行也可能已完成副作用。

lines.en: The pipeline's red before deployment here. Receipts show no deploy requests, right?
lines.zh: 这里流水线在部署前就红了。回执显示没有部署请求，对吧？

lines.en: Correct for these twelve failed attempts. I'll also check partial artifact uploads.
lines.zh: 这十二次失败确实如此。我还查部分上传的制品。

lines.en: I'm on it for queue snapshots. Duplicate manual retries are held separately.
lines.zh: 队列快照我来取。重复的手动重试单独挂起。

lines.en: Keep original run identifiers with attempts. Otherwise we'll lose the deduplication boundary.
lines.zh: 各次尝试保留原运行标识，否则会丢掉去重边界。

lines.en: So, hold new dispatch for now. Developers can still submit reviewed changes.
lines.zh: 那么先暂停新任务派发。开发仍可提交评审过的变更。

lines.en: I'll keep an eye on uploads. Any incomplete object stays outside release selection.
lines.zh: 我关注上传。任何不完整对象都不能进入发布选择。

lines.en: Fair, submissions aren't deployments or retries. I'll make that distinction quite clear.
lines.zh: 明白，提交不等于部署或重试。我会把区别说清楚。

dialogues.title: 健康执行器仍然下载失败
dialogues.premise: 队列已保存并暂停派发，十二个失败运行没有部署回执。
dialogues.listeningTask: 辨别执行器健康证据与尚未排除的配置问题。

lines.en: Runner health looks normal across pools. CPU and disk have enough room.
lines.zh: 各池执行器健康看起来正常。CPU和磁盘都有余量。

lines.en: Okay, queued builds remain held safely. What's the ETA for a control?
lines.zh: 好，排队构建继续安全挂起。对照测试预计多久？

lines.en: Use one isolated runner for comparison. Match its image and network policy.
lines.zh: 用一台隔离执行器做对照。镜像和网络策略保持一致。

lines.en: Same commit on both runners, right? Otherwise we'd change two variables together.
lines.zh: 两台用同一提交，对吧？不然一次改了两个变量。

lines.en: Use approved short-lived test credentials there. Don't copy production secrets into diagnostics.
lines.zh: 那里用批准的短期测试凭据。别把生产秘密复制进诊断。

lines.en: Both runners fail the same fetch. Managed configuration matches the approved image.
lines.zh: 两台都在同一下载处失败。受管配置与批准镜像相符。

lines.en: That weakens a single-host failure theory. It doesn't clear shared image configuration.
lines.zh: 这削弱了单机故障假设，但没有排除共享镜像配置。

lines.en: Just to confirm, don't recycle pools. We can't rule that out completely.
lines.zh: 确认一下，不重建执行器池。还不能完全排除它。

lines.en: The fetch error names an endpoint. Compare that with the approved source.
lines.zh: 下载错误指出一个端点。拿它和批准的源对比。

lines.en: Actually, that endpoint looks rather old. Let's check dependency settings next.
lines.zh: 其实那个端点看起来挺旧。接下来查依赖设置吧。

dialogues.title: 批准源正常，失败请求走旧地址
dialogues.premise: 隔离执行器也失败，日志里出现疑似旧依赖端点。
dialogues.listeningTask: 抓住连通性、授权和下载内容校验的区别。

lines.en: The approved dependency mirror answers normally. Failed requests use a retired address.
lines.zh: 批准的依赖镜像源响应正常。失败请求用了退役地址。

lines.en: Okay, runner health wasn't enough evidence. Just to confirm, approved credentials work?
lines.zh: 好，执行器健康还不够。确认一下，批准的凭据能用？

lines.en: A successful ping won't establish that. Test an authorized fetch with checksums.
lines.zh: ping成功证明不了。用授权下载加校验和测试。

lines.en: That fetch passed on the control. Lockfile hashes match the downloaded packages, right?
lines.zh: 对照下载通过了。锁文件哈希与下载包匹配，对吧？

lines.en: Yes, required package signatures passed too. No fallback to an unapproved public source.
lines.zh: 对，所需包签名也通过。不回退到未经批准的公共源。

lines.en: Let me tail the log again. The old address appears after cache restore.
lines.zh: 我再盯一下日志。旧地址在恢复缓存后出现。

lines.en: Before restore, the configuration points correctly. Keep that sequence with the evidence.
lines.zh: 恢复前配置指向正确地址。把这个顺序和证据一起保留。

lines.en: So, our working hypothesis has narrowed. Something restored overrides the dependency source.
lines.zh: 那么当前假设缩小了。恢复的某个内容覆盖了依赖源。

lines.en: We can rule that out narrowly. Approved-source availability isn't this observed failure.
lines.zh: 可以有限地排除：批准源不可用不是这次观察到的故障。

lines.en: Not every dependency issue, though... agreed. Inspect that cache without deleting evidence.
lines.zh: 但不能排除所有依赖问题……同意。检查缓存，别删证据。

dialogues.title: 缓存覆盖配置，不急着称为攻击
dialogues.premise: 旧地址在缓存恢复后出现；批准源授权下载与内容校验正常。
dialogues.listeningTask: 区分陈旧缓存和恶意污染的证据门槛。

lines.en: A cache hit restores local configuration. That file contains the retired address.
lines.zh: 一次缓存命中恢复了本地配置。文件里包含退役地址。

lines.en: Okay, is this cache poisoning then? Or just stale configuration carried forward?
lines.zh: 好，这就是缓存污染吗？还是旧配置被带了过来？

lines.en: Don't label it malicious without evidence. Compare cache creation records and access logs.
lines.zh: 没有证据别定性为恶意。对比缓存创建记录和访问日志。

lines.en: The dependency mirror changed last Tuesday. This cache predates that change, right?
lines.zh: 依赖镜像源上周二改过。这份缓存早于变更，对吧？

lines.en: Yes, its writer was an approved runner. No unauthorized writes found so far.
lines.zh: 对，写入者是批准的执行器。目前没有发现未授权写入。

lines.en: Cold runs pass; restored runs fail. I've preserved the cache object digest.
lines.zh: 冷构建通过，恢复缓存的失败。我保留了缓存对象摘要。

lines.en: That's useful paired evidence, not certainty. Why configuration was cached still needs investigation.
lines.zh: 这组证据有用，但还不是定论。为什么缓存配置仍需调查。

lines.en: Just to confirm, quarantine that object. The root cause is still open.
lines.zh: 确认一下，隔离那个对象。根因仍未完全查清。

lines.en: I'll keep an eye on access. Cache inspection mustn't reveal embedded credentials.
lines.zh: 我关注访问情况。检查缓存不能暴露嵌入的凭据。

lines.en: Understood, restricted inspection rather than downloads. Maybe cache scope was too broad.
lines.zh: 明白，受限检查，不随意下载。可能缓存范围太宽了。

dialogues.title: 绕过隔离缓存，不绕过安全门禁
dialogues.premise: 冷构建通过，旧缓存恢复配置导致失败；缓存对象已隔离并保留。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出临时绕行的范围、凭据处置和停止条件。

lines.en: Okay, bypass the cache for one run. This temporary workaround can buy us time.
lines.zh: 好，一次运行绕过缓存。这个临时措施可以争取时间。

lines.en: The isolated build uses approved settings. We keep verification enabled, right?
lines.zh: 隔离构建用批准设置。验证继续启用，对吧？

lines.en: Yes, no signature or checksum exceptions. Cap concurrency to protect the mirror.
lines.zh: 对，签名和校验和不能豁免。限制并发，保护镜像源。

lines.en: Could disabling all caches restore speed? Sorry, restore builds, not speed.
lines.zh: 关掉所有缓存能恢复速度吗？抱歉，是恢复构建，不是速度。

lines.en: Only the implicated cache is isolated. Wider changes would blur our evidence.
lines.zh: 只隔离涉事缓存。更广泛的变更会混淆证据。

lines.en: Restricted inspection found no stored credentials. I'll rotate the diagnostic credential anyway.
lines.zh: 受限检查未发现存储凭据。我仍会轮换诊断凭据。

lines.en: Revoke it after the approved test. If exposure appears, involve security immediately.
lines.zh: 批准测试后撤销它。若发现泄漏，立即找安全团队。

lines.en: Just to confirm, what's our rollback trigger? Invalid content means stop, not bypass verification.
lines.zh: 确认一下，回退触发条件是什么？内容无效就停止，不能绕过验证。

lines.en: And preserve any suspected cache poisoning evidence. Don't delete quarantined objects yet.
lines.zh: 也保留疑似缓存污染证据。暂时别删隔离对象。

lines.en: Fair, roughly one build first then. No deployment permission comes with this test.
lines.zh: 明白，那先大约一个构建。这个测试不附带部署许可。

dialogues.title: 构建绿了，制品还需证明来源
dialogues.premise: 批准一次绕过缓存的隔离构建，保留所有内容与安全校验。
dialogues.listeningTask: 区分构建成功、制品可信和发布获批。

lines.en: The controlled build passed its tests. Build provenance names the expected commit.
lines.zh: 受控构建测试通过。构建来源证明指向预期提交。

lines.en: Okay, we can bypass the cache safely. Just to confirm, signature verified too?
lines.zh: 好，可以安全绕过缓存。确认一下，签名也验证了？

lines.en: Against the approved signer identity, yes. A signature alone doesn't prove release approval.
lines.zh: 对，核对了批准的签名者身份。但签名本身不证明发布审批。

lines.en: The smoke test passes in staging. Production promotion stays separate, right?
lines.zh: 预发布冒烟测试通过。生产晋级仍然单独审批，对吧？

lines.en: Correct, record immutable digest and attestations. Secret scanning found no embedded credentials.
lines.zh: 对，记录不可变摘要和证明。秘密扫描未发现嵌入凭据。

lines.en: Diagnostic credentials are revoked after testing. Logs remain restricted and properly redacted.
lines.zh: 测试后诊断凭据已撤销。日志继续受限并已脱敏。

lines.en: Let's keep it under observation now. Mirror latency rose slightly during cold fetches.
lines.zh: 现在继续观察。冷下载时镜像源延迟略升。

lines.en: So, go/no-go for limited queue recovery? I'd keep concurrency at two.
lines.zh: 那么，有限恢复队列是继续还是停止？我建议并发保持两个。

lines.en: Two is within the tested capacity. Stop dispatch if latency exceeds that limit.
lines.zh: 两个在已测容量内。延迟超出那个限制就停止派发。

lines.en: Agreed, the tested limit is two seconds. We'll check retry eligibility before dispatch.
lines.zh: 同意，测试限制是两秒。派发前先检查重试资格。

dialogues.title: 去重后重试，确认副作用状态
dialogues.premise: 受控制品通过来源、签名和扫描检查；允许并发两个恢复构建队列。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听懂幂等键、已完成任务跳过及未知状态挂起。

lines.en: Each idempotent retry keeps its job key. Attempt identifiers remain separate for auditing.
lines.zh: 每次幂等重试保留任务键。尝试标识单独保留以便审计。

lines.en: Okay, queued builds need state checks. Just to confirm, duplicates won't deploy?
lines.zh: 好，排队构建需要查状态。确认一下，重复任务不会部署？

lines.en: Deployment uses its own idempotency ledger. Unknown outcomes stay held for reconciliation.
lines.zh: 部署使用独立幂等账本。结果未知的任务挂起核对。

lines.en: Completed jobs won't rebuild unnecessarily, right? We can reuse their verified digest.
lines.zh: 已完成任务不必重新构建，对吧？可以复用验证过的摘要。

lines.en: Only if build provenance still matches. Check signature, retention, and approval separately.
lines.zh: 只有构建来源仍匹配才行。签名、保留状态和审批分别检查。

lines.en: The twelve failures have no deployment effects. Duplicate requests resolve to original jobs.
lines.zh: 十二个失败任务没有部署副作用。重复请求归到原任务。

lines.en: Use bounded retries with backoff now. Authentication failures need repair, not repeated attempts.
lines.zh: 现在用有界退避重试。认证失败要修复，不能反复尝试。

lines.en: So, let the queue catch up slowly. Keep an eye on mirror latency.
lines.zh: 那么让队列慢慢追上。关注镜像源延迟。

lines.en: Partial uploads have been quarantined too. A retry mustn't promote an incomplete object.
lines.zh: 部分上传对象也已隔离。重试不能晋级不完整对象。

lines.en: Fair, I'll report pending work accurately. Held jobs aren't failures we can ignore.
lines.zh: 明白，我准确报告待办。挂起任务不是可以忽略的失败。

dialogues.title: 队列恢复不等于生产发布
dialogues.premise: 去重、有界重试和副作用核对后，队列逐步恢复，无未决部署结果。
dialogues.listeningTask: 抓住开发通知中恢复状态与仍有效的发布限制。

lines.en: Can we clear the backlog today? Developers are asking about their blocked releases.
lines.zh: 今天能清完积压吗？开发在问被阻塞的发布。

lines.en: Okay, what's the ETA at current speed? Keep this temporary workaround visible.
lines.zh: 好，按当前速度预计多久？临时绕行状态要明确保留。

lines.en: Around twenty minutes if latency holds. That's queue recovery, not release authorization.
lines.zh: 延迟保持的话大约二十分钟。这是队列恢复，不是发布授权。

lines.en: Each idempotent retry now passes consistently. No new source errors, right?
lines.zh: 现在各次幂等重试持续通过。没有新的源错误，对吧？

lines.en: Correct, verification remains enabled throughout recovery. Approved artifact identities stay in the record.
lines.zh: 对，恢复全程继续验证。批准的制品身份留在记录里。

lines.en: I'll close the loop with developers. They should check their original job link.
lines.zh: 我向开发反馈闭环。他们应查看原任务链接。

lines.en: And don't submit another duplicate run. That could consume our limited recovery capacity.
lines.zh: 别再提交重复运行，那会消耗有限恢复容量。

lines.en: Just to confirm, announce builds recovering only. Production gates and approvals still apply.
lines.zh: 确认一下，只宣布构建恢复中。生产门禁和审批仍有效。

lines.en: Include the restricted evidence reference internally. Customer-facing updates don't need runner details.
lines.zh: 内部附上受限证据引用。面向客户的更新不需要执行器细节。

lines.en: Actually, the last held job just cleared. I'll verify counts before announcing completion.
lines.zh: 其实最后一个挂起任务刚处理完。我先核实数量再宣布完成。

dialogues.title: 队列清完，缓存设计仍需修复
dialogues.premise: 队列任务均已核对完成，临时绕过缓存仍有效；安排永久修复。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出技术原因、流程缺口、负责人和验收证据。

lines.en: The cache key omitted mirror configuration. Old configuration survived that Tuesday change.
lines.zh: 缓存键遗漏镜像源配置。旧配置因此在周二变更后保留了。

lines.en: Okay, we did clear the backlog. First action item: scope caches correctly.
lines.zh: 好，积压确实清完了。第一个行动项：正确界定缓存范围。

lines.en: Exclude configuration and credentials from caching. Include lockfile, platform, and toolchain identities.
lines.zh: 配置和凭据不进缓存。键中包括锁文件、平台和工具链身份。

lines.en: Raj owns that patch tomorrow, right? I'll test changed mirror settings too.
lines.zh: Raj明天负责这个补丁，对吧？我也测试镜像源设置变更。

lines.en: I'll review cache writers and signatures. Existing evidence doesn't indicate malicious modification.
lines.zh: 我评审缓存写入者和签名。现有证据未显示恶意修改。

lines.en: Just to confirm, use managed configuration. No manual patch on shared runners.
lines.zh: 确认一下，用受管配置。不在共享执行器上手工打补丁。

lines.en: Add cold-versus-cached equivalence tests by Friday. Retest deduplication after simulated interrupted uploads.
lines.zh: 周五前加冷构建与缓存构建等价测试。模拟上传中断后重测去重。

lines.en: So, permanent repair needs reviewed evidence. We'll close the loop on Friday.
lines.zh: 那么永久修复需要评审过的证据。我们周五反馈闭环。

lines.en: Reenable only the corrected cache version. Keep old objects under evidence retention rules.
lines.zh: 只重新启用修正后的缓存版本。旧对象按证据保留规则处理。

lines.en: Fair, recovery is complete, repair isn't. I'll keep those statuses separate in updates.
lines.zh: 明白，恢复完成，修复未完成。我会在更新里区分两种状态。
